Scenario Name: Navigate to Activities Page and Verify Listing
Objective: Verify that clicking Activities in the nav menu loads the Activities page with activity cards.
Preconditions: Browser is open and navigated to https://www.district.in/ with Mumbai selected.

Scenario Name: Apply This Weekend Filter on Activities
Objective: Verify that the This Weekend filter refreshes the activities list to show only weekend activities.
Preconditions: User is on the Activities page (https://www.district.in/activities/).

Scenario Name: Sort Activities by Price Low to High
Objective: Verify that selecting Price: Low to High from the Filters panel reorders activities in ascending price order.
Preconditions: User is on the Activities page with This Weekend filter applied.

Scenario Name: Extract Activity Data into a Java Collection
Objective: Verify that activity name venue and price details are extracted from all visible cards and stored in a collection.
Preconditions: Activities page is filtered by This Weekend and sorted by Price: Low to High.

Scenario Name: Identify and Print the Lowest Priced Activity
Objective: Verify that the automation identifies the activity with the minimum price and prints its details to the console.
Preconditions: Activity data has been extracted and stored in a Java collection.

Scenario Name: Navigate to Movies Page and Verify Listing
Objective: Verify that clicking Movies in the nav menu loads the Movies page with movie cards.
Preconditions: Browser is open and navigated to https://www.district.in/ with Mumbai selected.

Scenario Name: Open Filters Panel and Extract Language Options
Objective: Verify that clicking the Filters button opens the panel and all language options in the Language section can be extracted and printed.
Preconditions: User is on the Movies page (https://www.district.in/movies/).

Scenario Name: Open Login Modal via User Avatar
Objective: Verify that clicking the User Avatar button opens the login modal with all required UI elements.
Preconditions: Any page of https://www.district.in/ is loaded and user is not logged in.

Scenario Name: Submit Invalid Mobile Number and Capture Error
Objective: Verify that entering an invalid mobile number and clicking Continue shows an error message.

Scenario Name: Take Screenshot After Login Error is Displayed
Objective: Verify that the automation takes a screenshot after the login error message appears.
Preconditions: Login modal shows an error message after invalid number submission.
